# Testing

Read `docs/guidance/engineering/testing.md` before writing or changing tests, or investigating a flaky test. It covers test layers, real dependencies, assertions, waits and isolation.

The `ce:writing-tests` skill goes deeper when installed. Follow the Testing section of `AGENTS.md` for the project's runners and harness, and its Commands table for supported commands.
